title: "hw1_dimmig"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)
library(tsibble)
library(fable)
library(feasts)
library(fabletools)
library(forecast)     
library(tsbox)        
library(zoo)
library(tseries)     
library(lubridate)

fred_url <- "https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=ICNSA"

icnsa_raw <- read.csv(fred_url, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(icnsa_raw) <- c("date", "value")

icnsa <- data.frame(
  date  = as.Date(icnsa_raw$date),
  ICNSA = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(icnsa_raw$value))
)

print(tail(icnsa, 5))

win_start   <- as.Date("2010-01-02")
target_date <- as.Date("2026-09-05")   # week we are forecasting

icnsa_win <- icnsa |> filter(date >= win_start, date < target_date)
cat("Modeling window:", format(min(icnsa_win$date)), "to", format(max(icnsa_win$date)),
    "(", nrow(icnsa_win), "observations )\n")

icnsa_win <- icnsa_win |>
  mutate(covid = as.integer(date >= as.Date("2020-03-14") & date <= as.Date("2021-03-31")))

ccnsa_raw <- read_csv(
  "https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=CCNSA",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  rename(date = observation_date, CCNSA = CCNSA) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  filter(!is.na(CCNSA))

dat <- icnsa_win |>
  inner_join(ccnsa_raw, by = "date") |>
  mutate(week = yearweek(date)) |>
  as_tsibble(index = week) |>
  mutate(log_ICNSA = log(ICNSA),
         log_CCNSA = log(CCNSA))

autoplot(dat, ICNSA) +
  labs(title = "Initial Claims (ICNSA), weekly, NSA", y = "Claims")

autoplot(dat, log_ICNSA) +
  labs(title = "log(ICNSA)", y = "log(Claims)")

dlog_ICNSA <- diff(dat$log_ICNSA)
dlog_CCNSA <- diff(dat$log_CCNSA)

ccf(dlog_ICNSA,dlog_CCNSA,10)

icnsa_win <- icnsa_win |> left_join(ccnsa_raw) |> arrange(date) |> mutate(logICNSA = log(ICNSA), logCCNSA_lag2 = lag(log(CCNSA),2))
reg_data <- icnsa_win |> filter(!is.na(logCCNSA_lag2))
model_df2 <- as.data.frame(cbind(logICNSA = reg_data$logICNSA, t = reg_data$t,
                                 covid = reg_data$covid, logCCNSA_lag2 = reg_data$logCCNSA_lag2))
reg_fit2 <- lm(logICNSA ~ ., data = model_df2)
summary(reg_fit2)

t0 <- min(reg_data$date)
t_target <- as.numeric(target_date - t0)/7
last_logCCNSA <- log(ccnsa_raw$CCNSA[ccnsa_raw$date == target_date - 14])
sep_5 <- as.data.frame(cbind(t = t_target, covid = 0, logCCNSA_lag2 = last_logCCNSA))

regression_predict_log <- predict(reg_fit2, newdata = sep_5,interval = "prediction", level = 0.95)
regression_predict <- exp(regression_predict_log)
print(regression_predict)


```
